tool_args.rationale: The initial fixed-gradient series is a smooth saturating response, while the targeted branch readings show strong dependence on sink gradient. Fit a compact cubic-in-u response with affine sink-gradient coupling to the complete training set.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch probe has already supplied two substantially different sink-gradient conditions; the resulting seven rows support fitting a smooth gradient-coupled response.
It cannot account for the large change in output under the open-branch probe as s_grad changes.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying this response and carries extra cost.
